segment.source:
::A well-knit man steps in front of you, crossing his arms and spreading his legs slightly apart. Simultaneously, he addresses you with a light, raspy voice.::
Hold't right thar, $(#jack/sister). This alley 'ere is belong to us. You wanna pass through, you gotta pay a one-time fee. Mhm.<end>
segment.target:
::A well-knit man steps in front of you, crossing his arms and spreading his legs slightly apart. Simultaneously, he addresses you with a light, raspy voice.::
Hold't right thar, $(#jack/sister). This alley 'ere is belong to us. You wanna pass through, you gotta pay a one-time fee. Mhm.<end>

segment.source: <end>
segment.target: <end>

segment.source: I'll pay you double if you can land a single punch on my face. Otherwise, you let me pass for free. Deal?<end>
segment.target: I'll pay you double if you can land a single punch on my face. Otherwise, you let me pass for free. Deal?<end>

segment.source: Doub-- Wait! Wait a sec'nd...<end>
segment.target: Doub-- Wait! Wait a sec'nd...<end>

segment.source: How do you--? I-- ::He begins to sweat.::<end>
segment.target: How do you--? I-- ::He begins to sweat.::<end>

segment.source: Hey, why did you not say you is *His* friend, huh? Psionic boy's. Go on through, yeah - go on through.<end>
segment.target: Hey, why did you not say you is *His* friend, huh? Psionic boy's. Go on through, yeah - go on through.<end>

segment.source: Alright, I'll pay. ::Pay 5 stygian coins.::<end>
segment.target: Alright, I'll pay. ::Pay 5 stygian coins.::<end>

segment.source: Good decision. You can pass now.<end>
segment.target: Good decision. You can pass now.<end>

segment.source: So what's the fee?<end>
segment.target: So what's the fee?<end>

segment.source: For a pretty girl like you... ::It takes a few seconds before his stare travels all over your body.:: make it five charons. Mhm.<end>
segment.target: For a pretty girl like you... ::It takes a few seconds before his stare travels all over your body.:: make it five charons. Mhm.<end>

segment.source: It's five charons.<end>
segment.target: It's five charons.<end>

segment.source: ::[Persuade]:: I already paid your fee.<end>
segment.target: ::[Persuade]:: I already paid your fee.<end>

segment.source: Yeah, right you did. Then how come you didn't know what the fee were, eh? Don't play no games with me, punk.<end>
segment.target: Yeah, right you did. Then how come you didn't know what the fee were, eh? Don't play no games with me, punk.<end>

segment.source: I don't think so. I would've remembered your mug.<end>
segment.target: I don't think so. I would've remembered your mug.<end>

segment.source: I was wearing a breathing mask then. I paid your three charons.<end>
segment.target: I was wearing a breathing mask then. I paid your three charons.<end>

segment.source: Ha, nice try, but that ain't the fee. No, no. It's five charons. Now get your ass outta 'ere and come back with some shinies.<end>
segment.target: Ha, nice try, but that ain't the fee. No, no. It's five charons. Now get your ass outta 'ere and come back with some shinies.<end>

segment.source: Well you have bad memory then, because I paid your five charons already.<end>
segment.target: Well you have bad memory then, because I paid your five charons already.<end>

segment.source: Hmm, yeah, I think I is rememberin' you, now that I thinks about it. Yeah. Pass.<end>
segment.target: Hmm, yeah, I think I is rememberin' you, now that I thinks about it. Yeah. Pass.<end>

segment.source: Come on, I already paid your ten charons yesterday! I was just wearing different clothes back then.<end>
segment.target: Come on, I already paid your ten charons yesterday! I was just wearing different clothes back then.<end>

segment.source: Fine.<end>
segment.target: Fine.<end>

segment.source: Come back when you got some shinies. Mhm.<end>
segment.target: Come back when you got some shinies. Mhm.<end>

segment.source: I ain't fallin' for that one.<end>
segment.target: I ain't fallin' for that one.<end>

segment.source: I'm on official business from South Gate Station. I don't need to pay any fees.<end>
segment.target: I'm on official business from South Gate Station. I don't need to pay any fees.<end>

segment.source: You is gonna pay like everyone else, southgater. Besides, what's a couple shinies for you SGS folk?<end>
segment.target: You is gonna pay like everyone else, southgater. Besides, what's a couple shinies for you SGS folk?<end>

segment.source: ::[Intimidate]:: I'm not paying you anything, you mangy street rat. Now step aside before I turn your brain into graffiti.<end>
segment.target: ::[Intimidate]:: I'm not paying you anything, you mangy street rat. Now step aside before I turn your brain into graffiti.<end>

segment.source: You either very brave or very stupid, $(#jack/sister), threatening me on my home turf.<end>
segment.target: You either very brave or very stupid, $(#jack/sister), threatening me on my home turf.<end>

segment.source: ::[Intimidate]:: I don't need to be brave. I've got enough firepower to blow you and your little cardboard city to Upper Underrail. I'll be passing through here now unless you want a demonstration?<end>
segment.target: ::[Intimidate]:: I don't need to be brave. I've got enough firepower to blow you and your little cardboard city to Upper Underrail. I'll be passing through here now unless you want a demonstration?<end>

segment.source:
::His stare is nothing but anger, but after exchanging it with his comrades, he motions you to pass.::
You good to pass.<end>
segment.target:
::His stare is nothing but anger, but after exchanging it with his comrades, he motions you to pass.::
You good to pass.<end>

segment.source: That was a terrible bluff. Put $(#him/her) outta $(#his/her) misery, boys.<end>
segment.target: That was a terrible bluff. Put $(#him/her) outta $(#his/her) misery, boys.<end>

segment.source: It won't be your turf for long. ::Attack!::<end>
segment.target: It won't be your turf for long. ::Attack!::<end>

segment.source: You ain't even gonna have time to regret what you just said. Get this idiot!<end>
segment.target: You ain't even gonna have time to regret what you just said. Get this idiot!<end>

segment.source: Forget it. I'll take another way around.<end>
segment.target: Forget it. I'll take another way around.<end>

segment.source: Ain't no other way around. You'll be back. Mhm.<end>
segment.target: Ain't no other way around. You'll be back. Mhm.<end>

segment.source: Oops, I think I got lost. I'll be going now.<end>
segment.target: Oops, I think I got lost. I'll be going now.<end>

segment.source: We got no more business to do. Move along, $(#jack/sister).<end>
segment.target: We got no more business to do. Move along, $(#jack/sister).<end>

segment.source: Shinies - got 'em?<end>
segment.target: Shinies - got 'em?<end>
